thread:
mike (PM): Trial with VertexPartners surfaced a weird ask: they want a "Commitment Split"—half of committed spend applied to low-cost embedding tier, half to high-priority generation. They want rollup reporting and separate overage behavior per bucket. Can product decide viability?

anya (Eng): Technically doable via two commitment buckets and tagging usage. Main infra work is ensuring committed credits are consumed in the right order and billing precedence logic.

derek (Sales): VP will only sign if the contract reflects separate burn rules + ability to transfer leftover credits monthly. They also want a cap on generation spend before overage blocks.

clara (Legal): Need precise language: "Committed Credits" division, transfer window (e.g., monthly rollover up to X%), and overage handling per bucket. Also include dispute resolution for billing allocation.

mike (PM): Proposed product approach: implement two named commitment SKUs (EmbedCommit, GenCommit). Console shows split, burn order (configurable), and an optional "auto-transfer" flag subject to cap. GA criteria: clear UI, billing math validated, contract language in place, and at least one pilot.

tess (Solutions): UX must show projected depletion timelines for each bucket and warn when Gen bucket low. Also include an emergency top-up flow in Console (with audit).

anya (Eng): Estimate: tagging + billing precedence = 2 sprints; rollover + transfer rules = 3 sprints; blocking on gen overage = 2 sprints. Need to prioritize which features ship in pilot.

derek (Sales): We'll accept pilot with manual transfer (sales-assisted) + console visibility. VP wants hard block in GA.

ci-bot: pipeline:feature-flag "commitment-split-v1" created; smoke tests queued.

mike (PM): Decision: ship v1 pilot with separate SKUs, UI reporting, and manual transfer via Sales. GA scope includes auto-transfer, programmable burn-order, and hard-blocking per gen bucket. Actions: Anya -> RFC & timeline; Tess -> mock UI + estimator; Clara -> contract language; Derek -> pilot terms. Sync Wed 9am. :white_check_mark:
